title: Make library contracts and portable guides easy to navigate
problem: The top-level README combines setup, output contracts, all optional families and research links in one dense page.
design: Keep one short entry page and move detailed output/customization/configuration contracts into a linked API guide. Feature guides remain with their implementations; build and conformance pages use the actual split test names.
tradeoffs: Readers follow focused pages for detail. Documentation describes supported contracts and sampled tests rather than implying universal backend or fmt conformance.

commands: Check all repository-relative Markdown links against the assembled checkout.
Review examples against the public base and optional-header interfaces; formatter implementation is unchanged.
validation.results: Pending independent review and assembled portable validation.
validation.limitations: Documentation/link checks are read-only. Existing portable tests substantiate examples; no hardware campaign rerun follows this navigation change.

source_changes: Build integration and documentation only; no formatter implementation changes.
